speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what are the recommended guidelines used to assess MediFund applications, including the quantum of assistance to be provided; (b) what degree of autonomy do MediFund Committees have to make decisions on such applications; and (c) what measures are in place to ensure consistency of interpretation of these guidelines by MediFund Committees across the MediFund-approved institutions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: They work with the medical social workers (MSWs) to assess applications holistically, taking into account patients’ socio-economic and health circumstances, as well as bill sizes.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Just one supplementary question, which is to confirm the understanding that MOH provides guidelines as to the quantum, the way in which you do the means testing for MediFund, but those guidelines, if I understand it correctly, are not binding on the different MediFund Committees, so they have the discretion to deviate from those guidelines, depending on their case-by-case assessment.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: The second supplementary question is, if that is the case, then what process is in place to ensure that there is a basic degree of consistency?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Because otherwise, you could get some MediFund Committees being more generous than others, depending on the hospital or the healthcare provider.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: In terms of the outcomes, I think that is the fundamental and most important thing.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Despite all the guidelines, are we able to assist most of these people and patients who are in need.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, I think the outcome speak for itself that regardless of the guidelines, most of these applications actually receive the assistance they require and most of them in full, as well.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, those who are already on our radar, who are in need, will receive the necessary support, without further application.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, I think there are robust processes in place to make sure that the MediFund Committees perform their roles well and the outcomes, in terms of the numbers that have been assisted, also validate this observation.
